findings.PRISM-GRAY-BPC-001: interop-psd defect reproduced exactly (test interop_psd_gray_bpc_repro_still_reproduces: gray 0.25 -> 0.85 with BPC on, source_black_lstar -3613.19, scale 0.2; BPC off correct). curv gamma 1.8: L* -1.49e11, scale 6e-9. NOT Gray-specific, see PRISM-RGB-BPC-CURV-GAMMA-001 and PRISM-CURV-GAMMA-ZERO-001.
findings.PRISM-RGB-BPC-CURV-GAMMA-001: Same garbage black point on RGB matrix profiles with curv count=1 gamma 1.8: T0 srgb_curv18_bpc_to_srgb_linear (all 23 patches destroyed with BPC on, control with BPC off exact); T1 m_prophoto_to_srgb and m_srgb_to_prophoto with BPC on: mean dE2000 42 / 50, max ~100 (ProPhoto.icm = curv gamma 1.8).
findings.PRISM-CURV-GAMMA-ZERO-001: Not BPC related: RGB source with curv count=1 gamma below 2.2 converts a pixel that has an exact 0.0 channel next to non-zero channels to XYZ 0. Sweep (T0 curv_gamma_*_mixed_zero_to_xyz_d50, u8Fixed8): 1.0 and 2.2/2.4 correct; 1.5, 1.8, 2.0 lose the pixel (primaries and secondaries -> XYZ 0); 2.1 off by up to 4.9e-4. Installed ProPhoto RGB as a source: T1 src_leg_prophoto mean dE2000 22.9, max 106 (yellow (1,1,0) -> black). The T1 pair m_prophoto_to_srgb hides it because those patches are outside the sRGB gamut mask. Cause UNVERIFIED (moxcms gamma curve evaluation at exactly 0.0 suspected).
findings.PRISM-SOURCE-XYZ-NEGATIVE-CLAMP-001: Source leg clamps negative PCS XYZ to 0. Display P3 red has Z -0.001053 after Bradford adaptation (T0 p3_para3_to_xyz_d50: got 0, want -0.0010529); T1 src_leg_image_p3 max dE 0.62 and src_leg_synth_rgb_v2_table 0.62 (gate 0.1), ACEScg (Z -0.006) max dE 3.27.
findings.PRISM-HDR-SOURCE-CLAMP-001: Rec2100HLG203.icc (v4 mAB) as a source: PCS Y saturates at 1.000 from HLG signal 0.75 up, lcms2 continues 1.473, 2.189, 3.275, 4.923 at signal 13/16..16/16 (src_leg_rec2100_hlg203 mean dE 12.5, max 44.9). HDR highlights are lost.
findings.PRISM-LUT-DEST-ACCURACY-001: PCS -> CMYK table destinations deviate from exact table evaluation, worst in shadows. In-gamut Lab -> CMYK (dst legs, relative): SWOP mean 1.36 max 5.7, FOGRA39 1.40/7.8, synthetic CMYK 2.9/14.2 (gate mean 0.5, max 1.5). Pairs RGB->CMYK relative BPC off: mean 0.53-0.68, max 1.8-11.6; CMYK->CMYK SWOP->FOGRA39 mean 1.72 max 9.6. CMYK sources are fine (src_leg_swop max 0.27, fogra39 0.18, gracol 0.14). Cause UNVERIFIED (hypothesis: the PCS leg is re-baked on an XYZ-linear grid that is too coarse in shadows).
findings.PRISM-LUT-SOURCE-REBAKE-001: Marginal: coarse 7^4 synthetic CMYK A2B as a source, saturation: max dE 1.52-1.57 vs the 1.5 gate (l_synth_cmyk_to_srgb); relative src_leg max 1.37.
findings.PRISM-BPC-CMYK-BLACK-001: Relative BPC from a CMYK source: engine local-black L* 16.51 (SWOP) / 10.66 (FOGRA39) against 16.59 / 10.68 measured through lcms2 (Lab(0,0,0) -> B2A0 -> A2B1); the 0.08 L* gap is amplified near black: SWOP, FOGRA39, GRACoL relative BPC on mean 0.18-0.52, max 3.2-8.0 dE2000 (BPC off: max 0.27).
findings.PRISM-CURV-TABLE-INTERP-001: curv table TRC is not evaluated by linear interpolation: 33-entry table x^2.4, RGB path max error 1.16e-4 (lcms2 is within 1.8e-5 of linear interpolation), gray kTRC path max 4.4e-5 over 1025 inputs. Negligible for real 1024+ entry tables but above the 1/65535 gate.
findings.PRISM-TABLE-TRC-INVERSE-001: Destination curv table (1024-entry sRGB table) inverse is off by up to 3.8e-4 in device value (parametric type 3 destination: 4e-6). Out-of-gamut values clamp cleanly for both (T0 lab_to_srgb_*_clipped).
findings.PRISM-MISSING-INTENT-TABLE-REFUSAL-001: HLG203 has A2B0/A2B1 only: saturation is refused with typed MissingIntentTable where lcms2 converts with a fallback table. Whether ICC.1 mandates the fallback (A2B0) is UNVERIFIED here; research topic engine-color H9 lists it.

divergences_not_defects_pending_decision.DIV-ABS-V2-DISPLAY-WTPT-001: Absolute colorimetric with v2 display profiles (HP sRGB, Adobe RGB 1998: wtpt D65): lcms2 reads the wtpt of a v2 display profile as D50 (probe: editing the wtpt changes nothing), the engine uses the tag (formula MW_src/MW_dst, T0-verified). Verified by experiment: with wtpt forced to D50 the engine agrees with lcms2 (matrix pairs max dE 0.001-0.047; installed CMYK->RGB max 0.2-0.27, coarse synthetic CMYK 1.38, HLG 0.36). Needs a Studio/Operator decision and a T3 (Photoshop ACE) reading.
divergences_not_defects_pending_decision.DIV-V4-PERCEPTUAL-BLACK-001: lcms2 forces BPC for perceptual/saturation when the destination is a v4 profile (data: its perceptual BPC-off output is bit-identical to relative BPC-on for m_synth_v2table_to_synth_v4para4); the engine keeps BPC an independent flag (STU-COL-136) and agrees with lcms2 once BPC is on (that combo passes). Also HLG perceptual with BPC on (lcms2 uses a v4 perceptual reference black, engine equal black points).
divergences_not_defects_pending_decision.DIV-CMYK-PERCEPTUAL-BPC-BLACK-001: Perceptual/saturation BPC from a v2 CMYK source: engine black L* 1.43 (SWOP, local black) vs lcms2 darkest colorant (400% ink, L* 0.0; effective black Y fitted from a K ramp = 0): different black point algorithms (ISO 18619 CD vs lcms2); SWOP, FOGRA39, GRACoL perceptual/saturation BPC on: mean 0.24-0.63, max 1.8-5.1.
